site.title: 0xTsoa — Reproducible Linux Dotfiles & Desktop Registry
site.description: Open, zero-database Linux dotfiles registry of reproducible Wayland and X11 desktop configs (Hyprland, Niri, Sway, i3, BSPWM) with pinned install scripts.

hero.title: REPRODUCIBLE LINUX DESKTOP CONFIGS & DOTFILES.
hero.subtitle: 0xTsoa (pronounced ZeroTsoa) is an open-source registry of reproducible Linux desktop configurations, created by Ny Harena RAVELOMANANTSOA, a Malagasy developer. Browse peer-reviewed Hyprland, Niri, Sway, i3, and BSPWM setups for Arch Linux, NixOS, and Fedora. Inspect component specs, verify SHA-256 install scripts, and deploy from pinned Git commits.

spotlight.title: TOP 5 SPOTLIGHT
spotlight.signOffNotice: Votes counted from +1, heart, and hooray reactions on each setup's GitHub vote issue.

manifesto.heading: Registry Architecture & Verification Model
manifesto.card1Text: 0xTsoa (spoken "ZeroTsoa") is an open, static registry for discovering, auditing, and reproducing Linux desktop configurations across Wayland compositors and X11 window managers.
manifesto.card2Text: Complete Hyprland rice setups, Niri, Sway, i3, and BSPWM configs for Arch Linux, NixOS, Fedora, and Void—indexed by bar, terminal, launcher, and theme palette.
manifesto.card3Text:
1. Filter projects by desktop part, compositor, distro, or theme.
2. Inspect the pinned upstream README, keybindings, and component specs.
3. Clone the pinned commit or run the SHA-256 verified install script.
manifesto.card4Text: No accounts, tracking, or backend database. Every configuration is a schema-validated JSON file in Git, and community votes come directly from GitHub issue reactions.

catalogue.metaTitle: Linux Dotfiles Catalogue — Hyprland, Sway, Niri, i3 & BSPWM
catalogue.metaDescription: Filter reproducible Linux desktop configs and dotfiles by compositor (Hyprland, Sway, Niri, i3, BSPWM), distro (Arch Linux, NixOS, Fedora), desktop part and theme.

spec.securityNotice: Security: Always inspect external scripts before local execution. Command pinned to an immutable SHA-256 digest.

contribute.metaTitle: Submit a Linux Desktop Config or Dotfiles Setup
contribute.metaDescription: Submit your Hyprland, Sway, Niri, i3, or BSPWM dotfiles to 0xTsoa via GitHub Issue Form or Pull Request with automated Zod schema and SHA-256 validation.
contribute.title: SUBMIT A CONFIGURATION TO 0xTsoa
contribute.subtitle: Zero-database submission pipeline: submit a GitHub Issue Form or open a Pull Request against configs/<author>/<slug>.json.
contribute.method1Desc: Add configs/<github-handle>/<slug>.json with a category, a pinned Git commit or tag and at least one install step, then open a Pull Request. CI validates the Zod schema, image hosts, and script checksums.
contribute.method2Desc: Fill out the structured GitHub Issue Form (desktop part, screenshots, install commands). The issue-to-config Action computes the script SHA-256 digest, validates the JSON entry, and opens a Pull Request.
